svg.title: Numerical observations
svg.desc: 3274 plus 27 equals 3301. 26083 is the 2867th prime. 2163 factors into 3 times 7 times 103, the rune prime values in YOU. Intentionality is unproven.

g.aria-label: GP = the Gematria Primus prime values assigned to runes.
These are exact arithmetic observations. Whether they were intentional remains open.
